dial.summary: October NFP beat (+165K vs ~65K consensus) pushed DXY to 102.33 and reinforces December FOMC hiking odds, but macro remains constructive — 5/8 indicators supportive as real yields extended their 4-week decline (-30bps to 2.63%), Global M2 holds $104.3T, ISM Manufacturing sits at a 10th-expansion-month 55.5, and Fed balance sheet flat at $6.75T; BTC perpetual funding collapsed to near-zero (0.0019%) and Fear & Greed sits at 25 (Extreme Fear) while BTC.D holds firm at ~59.3% — a classic accumulation setup with no alt-rotation catalyst in view; November 10 CPI is the decisive input for the December 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) holds at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B; October G4 data not yet published — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month, so October G4 update expected mid-November 2026); US M2 at $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds flat threshold — trend UP; Bitrue broader global estimate ~$103.66T; status supportive (4-week trend up); held unchanged from Nov 7 run — October G4 data publication pending mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.6%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Prices 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026 (November data); value unchanged — monthly series, October reading is current.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot 102.33 as of November 6, 2026 close — rallied +0.77% on the day after October NFP beat (+165K vs ~65K consensus, unemployment fell to 4.1%); intraweek low was ~101.20 (post-Democrat midterm sweep Nov 3); 4-week trend UP — from ~101.5–101.8 range (Oct 5–7) to 102.33 (Nov 6), net change approximately +0.68% exceeds the 0.5% flat threshold; prior 52-week high 102.95 (Oct 14, 2026); status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.63% on November 6, 2026 (Trading Economics Nov 6; Fed H.15 showed 2.65% Nov 3, 2.64% Nov 4, 2.60% Nov 5); 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.93% on September 29 to ~2.63% on November 6, approximately -30bps; real yields have declined as nominal 10Y fell on Democrat midterm fiscal restraint expectations and then partially retraced post-NFP; status supportive (falling trend — the headwind rule requires rising AND above 2% simultaneously, only one condition met).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: Post-NFP (Nov 6, +165K beat): short end likely bear-flattened as front-end yields repriced December hike higher; pre-NFP Nov 4 reads: 10Y 4.90% / 2Y 4.58% = +0.32%, or 10Y 4.95% / 2Y 4.61% = +0.34%; using +0.30% for Nov 7 reflecting bear-flattening pressure from strong payrolls; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~+0.40% around October 7 to ~+0.30% on November 7, -10bps flattening; curve remains well above -50bps headwind threshold; status neutral (positive but flattening on 4-week basis, not sustainably steepening).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,748,145M ($6.748T) for week ended November 4, 2026 (FRED updated November 5; next H.4.1 release November 12); prior readings: Oct 28 $6,745,635M, Oct 21 $6,753,604M, Oct 14 $6,755,639M; 4-week change Oct 14 → Nov 4: $6.756T → $6.748T = -$8M, essentially flat; balance sheet stabilized post-QT-pause (QT ended December 2025); oscillating in a narrow ~$10B band; status supportive (flat, no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Deribit BTC perpetual funding rate at 0.0019% per 8h as of November 6–7, 2026 — 'practically zero'; market-wide funding fell below 0.005% as trade-war fears and post-October-30 crash deleveraging weighed on sentiment; BTC futures open interest declined 1.88% to $52.04B in 24h; Fear & Greed Index at 25 (Extreme Fear); BTC trading ~$76K; 30-day trend DOWN (down from 0.0087% on Nov 6 prior run, compressing toward zero post-crash); status supportive (near zero, well below 0.04% headwind threshold).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: DefiLlama stablecoin total market cap ~$291.6B as of November 6, 2026 (USDT dominance 60.87%, USDT $177.5B, USDC $70.7B); total crypto market cap ~$2.57T (Nov 7 snapshot: $2.55–2.58T, BTC dominance ~59–60%, BTC ~$76K); implied stablecoin dominance $291.6B/$2.57T ≈ 11.4%; 30-day trend UP — October crash compressed TOTAL from ~$2.86T (Oct 1) to ~$2.57T (Nov 7) while stablecoins held ~$291–292B; status neutral — headwind requires rising dominance AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL is still below Oct 1 level so headwind condition not met.

upcoming.title: CPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Consumer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — the last inflation report the Fed receives before the December 9 FOMC vote (November CPI publishes Dec 10, the day after the decision); consensus: +0.3% MoM headline, 3.7% YoY, core +0.2% MoM / 2.6% YoY; October NFP beat (+165K, unemployment 4.1%) strengthened the case for a December hike — a hot CPI above 3.7% would seal it; a print near 3.0% could keep December in play as a pause.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 8, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims released Wednesday November 12 (shifted one day earlier from normal Thursday due to Veterans Day federal holiday November 11); first labor pulse following the strong October NFP (+165K, unemployment 4.1%); context: a print below 215K would reinforce December hike odds; a spike above 230K would re-open debate about labor-market cooling ahead of the FOMC blackout period (November 28).

upcoming.title: PPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Producer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — consensus: +0.3% MoM headline and core; September PPI was 6.3% YoY and ISM Manufacturing Prices remains at 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70), signaling persistent upstream cost pressure; completes the November inflation picture alongside CPI (Nov 10) and provides the final inflation input set for the December FOMC dot plot revision.
